contest_failure_reason.name: contest_failure_reason
contest_failure_reason.value: "contests"."stage" != 'failed' or length(trim("contests"."failure_reason")) > 0 and "contests"."failure_reason" is not null

contest_schedule.name: contest_schedule
contest_schedule.value: ("contests"."preparation_at" is null or "contests"."preparation_at" <= "contests"."submissions_start_at") and "contests"."submissions_start_at" < "contests"."submissions_end_at" and "contests"."submissions_end_at" <= "contests"."round_one_start_at" and "contests"."round_one_start_at" < "contests"."ends_at" and ("contests"."round_two_start_at" is null or ("contests"."round_one_start_at" < "contests"."round_two_start_at" and "contests"."round_two_start_at" < "contests"."ends_at"))

story_ai_percentage.name: story_ai_percentage
story_ai_percentage.value: "stories"."ai_generation_basis_points" is null or (typeof("stories"."ai_generation_basis_points") = 'integer' and "stories"."ai_generation_basis_points" between 0 and 10000)

story_length.name: story_length
story_length.value: ("stories"."length" is null and "stories"."length_algorithm" is null) or ("stories"."length" is not null and "stories"."length" >= 0 and "stories"."length_algorithm" is not null)

story_withdrawal.name: story_withdrawal
story_withdrawal.value: "stories"."status" != 'withdrawn' or ("stories"."withdrawn_at" is not null and "stories"."withdrawal_reason" is not null)

story_round_withdrawal.name: story_round_withdrawal
story_round_withdrawal.value: "story_rounds"."status" != 'withdrawn' or ("story_rounds"."withdrawn_at" is not null and "story_rounds"."withdrawal_reason" is not null)

story_round_results.name: story_round_results
story_round_results.value: ("story_rounds"."points" is null or "story_rounds"."points" >= 0) and ("story_rounds"."place" is null or "story_rounds"."place" > 0)
